We've attached the workbook (Orion_RFP_DedicatedSizing.xlsx). Happy to set a 45-min call to review.

From: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
To: olga.petrov@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: diego.fernandez@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 9 Nov 2027 07:58:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: draft reservation plan for Orion (do not send)

Team —

Draft notes ahead of the call:

1) Workload profile normalized (10M tokens/day):
   - Chat: 3M tokens/day (30%), median seq 96, tail 512, streaming required
   - Completion: 5M tokens/day (50%), median seq 64
   - Embeddings: 2M tokens/day (20%), seq 128 (batchable)

2) Performance targets: p50 chat 120ms, completion 90ms, embeddings 50ms (per-orion ask).

3) Initial GPU blend recommendation (steady-state):
   - 60% H100s (int8 quantized variants) for chat/completion latency-sensitive paths
   - 30% A100s for throughput/embeddings (better batch density)
   - 10% T4 inference pool for low-cost background embedding reindexing and non-critical batch work

4) Reservation sizing:
   - Baseline pool sized to cover 90% of steady-state token throughput with autoscale headroom for 25% diurnal spike (recommend reserve = steady_state * 0.9 to 1.0 depending on commit tolerance).
   - For 10M tokens/day, expected sustained GPU-hours estimate = ~3600 GPU-hours/month (ballpark). Recommend committed GPU-month equivalent: 2800–3200 GPU-hours (reserve + buffer).

5) Burst strategy:
   - Allow 3x short-term burst via burst credits + spot pools; enforce fallback policy to quantized variants (H100-quant -> A100-quant degrade) with documented latency deltas.

6) SLA & fallback:
   - Soft-fallback supported; explicit degradation tiers in SLA (e.g., 5% p50 increase tolerated when fallback invoked). Need procurement sign-off.

7) Next artifacts to produce before call: kernel-fit latency matrix (H100 vs A100 vs T4) per seq length; cost delta spreadsheet; reservation runway scenarios (6/12/24 months).

Diego: can you pull kernel-fit numbers for 96/512/64 seq lengths and populate latency-throughput-matrix.csv?

Karthik
Head of Capacity Planning, Redwood Inference

(ON CALL: Tue 2027-11-09 10:00 PT)

From: diego.fernandez@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Internal: draft reservation plan for Orion (do not send)

Folks —

Attached kernel-fit CSV and a quick excerpt below. Numbers are p50 token-generation latencies (ms) measured on our internal bench for the model family Orion specified: 

- Seq 64: H100 int8 = 75ms, A100 fp16 = 94ms, T4 fp16 = 220ms
- Seq 96: H100 int8 = 98ms, A100 fp16 = 120ms, T4 fp16 = 260ms
- Seq 512: H100 int8 = 340ms, A100 fp16 = 420ms, T4 fp16 = 980ms

Cost per GPU-hour (on dedicated pricing, approximate): H100 = $5.70, A100 = $3.20, T4 = $0.90.

I've attached latency-throughput-matrix.csv and a short cost sensitivity tab. These validate the H100-heavy approach for latency-critical chat/completion and A100 for embeddings density.

Diego
Performance Engineer, Redwood Inference

(attachment: latency-throughput-matrix.csv)
